summary: The GroupWorksheet system in HSPnet is a web-based interface designed to manage educational programs' scheduling and enrolment processes, emphasizing group assignments and worksheet management.
purpose: To facilitate the management of educational program details, including scheduling, enrolment, and organization of group worksheets, using web controls and backend data operations.

workflows.name: CheckGoToAccess
steps: Check whether user can access specific parts of the system based on session variables and current selections.

workflows.name: SearchWorksheet
steps: Use session and dropdown values to filter and display worksheet details.

workflows.name: FillWorksheetFilters
steps: Load data into dropdowns for sites, services, instructors, dates, campuses, and sections.

business_rules: Auto-generated fields should not be modified directly.
Session variables dictate user access and view settings.
validations: Ensure all status filters are checked for certain operations.
Dropdowns must be populated with valid data.
calculations: Determine EnrolledStudentCount based on worksheet details.
conditions: Visibility of controls is dependent on session variables and user status.
system_behavior: The worksheet page dynamically loads and refreshes data based on user interactions and session data.
dependencies: User session management is critical for page operations.
Dropdowns are dependent on valid data sources for accurate display.
exceptions: No available data should safely hide dropdowns and related content.
